abstract: We exhibit a congruence subgroup $\Gamma\subset\operatorname{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ of level $120$ and index $23040$ whose modular curve $X_\Gamma$ has genus $1777$ and whose Jacobian is isogenous over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ to a product of elliptic curves. This surpasses the previous record of a completely decomposable complex Jacobian of dimension $1297$ found by Ekedahl and Serre in $1993$.
hook: A modular curve of genus 1777 has a Jacobian that splits into elliptic curves, a new record.
summary: A modular curve is a geometric object built from symmetries of the integers, and its Jacobian is a related higher-dimensional shape. The author finds a level-120 example whose Jacobian is isogenous to a product of elliptic curves, beating the 1993 record of dimension 1297. This is an existence example found for one group, not a general classification.
title: A completely decomposable modular Jacobian of dimension $1777$
